SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    f.Free_Meal_Count__Ages_5_17__ > 800
    AND s.County = 'Monterey'
ORDER BY 
    f.Free_Meal_Count__Ages_5_17__;

SELECT 
    s.School,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Zip
FROM 
    frpm f
